title: The image of a universally closed scheme under a surjection is universally closed
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $p:X\to S$ and $q:Y\to S$ morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism with $q\circ f=p$. If $p$ is universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $f$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], then $q$ is universally closed. In particular, if moreover $q$ is separated and locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], then $q$ is proper.
